To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a framework to rapidly synthesize 3D LiDar point clouds with accurate annotations from a virtual world.

we propose a framework that can rapidly create 3D LiDar point clouds with accurate labels from a computer virtual world; we show the synthesized point cloud data can improve the accuracy of deep learning algorithms; we show the framework can also be used for systematic testing and retraining of deep learning algorithms.

(1) we present a framework that can generate point clouds with accurate labels from computer game; (2) the generated point clouds can be used to improve the performance of a deep neural network in point cloud segmentation task; (3) point clouds from user configured scenes can be used systematically to test and retrain the neural network to make the network more robust.

the creation of a large amount of point cloud data with accurate point-level annotation.

how to generate large 3D point clouds with accurate labels for autonomous driving tasks, and how to use the generated data to systematically test and improve the robustness of neural network algorithms.
creating large-scale point cloud data with point-level labels from computer games for autonomous driving.
